primary_source_limitations: Canada CGNDB records were fetched as exact JSON response bodies from Natural Resources Canada GeoGratis and saved with SHA-256 receipts. The Open Government Portal identifies the dataset as authoritative and licensed under Open Government Licence - Canada.

Petersburg and Haines were queried directly from Alaska Department of Fish and Game ArcGIS GNIS mirror by GNIS feature ID. Exact JSON response body and SHA-256 receipt are saved. USGS identifies GNIS as the official U.S. domestic geographic names repository; the query geometry is EPSG:4326 and matches the primary latitude/longitude attributes.
